blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Union Bank of the Philippines is prepared to inject fresh capital into its digital banking unit, UnionDigital Bank, if the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) rejects its request for regulatory relief as the lender moves to absorb the subsidiary.
